title: ADR-027: MIA Cloud Architecture — Cloud MVP Implementation
description: Implement MIA Cloud extensions per ADR-027: per-tenant JWT bridge auth, session restoration on boot, graceful shutdown, Platform Admin tenant lifecycle (suspend/recover/delete), hybrid provisioning API, deployment_model and status columns on businesses. Council §4.1 decision: Model A (Shared Everything) for Cloud MVP with evolution path to Model B/C via deployment_model flag. Platform/Core domain per ADR-025 §3.1.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX. Primary domain: platform. Complexity drivers: 18 files affected, schema changes required, security implications (JWT bridge auth, cross-tenant isolation), infrastructure topology decision, category requires council. Council §4.1 selects Model A for MVP. Required agents (14): architect, domain_expert, product_manager, database, backend, frontend, performance, security, qa, godzilla, release, infrastructure_bootstrap, infrastructure_guardian, memory_engineer.

decisions.rationale: §4.1 Council Decision: Model A (Shared Everything) for Cloud MVP. RLS proven, JWT closes bridge gap, deployment_model enables evolution to B/C without rewrite. Aligns with §13.1 MVP phase and §15 deferrals.
Platform/Core domain boundary preserved. Tenant lifecycle states (§3.4) map cleanly to deployment_model managed/dedicated-db/dedicated. No Sales domain leakage.
Product promise satisfied: client consumes MIA without administering infrastructure. Model A is simplest onboarding path. Enterprise escape hatch via deployment_model override.
Schema change minimal: deployment_model + status columns on businesses. RLS unchanged. Model A requires no per-tenant Supabase provisioning automation.
JWT bridge auth (jose), session restoration, lifecycle APIs follow existing admin patterns from ADR-026. Model A keeps single Supabase admin client.
TenantLifecyclePanel + ProvisioningWizard extend Platform Admin. deployment_model visible in TenantTable for admin override to B/C.
Model A: single DB, indexed RLS function acceptable to 100 tenants per §13.2. Re-evaluate read replicas at 50+ tenants.
Model A acceptable with per-tenant JWT (§5), audit of 79 admin call sites (0b), and Platform Admin fail-closed guard. Blast radius mitigated not eliminated.
Full quality gates: lint, build, unit_tests, e2e_tests, chrome_devtools, security_review, stress_test. platform-admin.test.ts extended for lifecycle endpoints.
Stress vectors: JWT cross-tenant spoofing, bridge secret fallback during migration, session restoration race, suspend bypass via admin client, deployment_model escalation without auth.
Phased commits per §14 dependency graph. ADR-027 §4.1 decision committed before Phase 1 implementation. Governance manifest TASK-20260820-ADR027 approved.
Model A: no new Supabase/Vercel/Fly projects required. JWT keys via env vars only. Bridge deploy unchanged (single Fly app).
Environment baseline unchanged for Model A. PLATFORM_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY + PUBLIC_KEY new vars — document in baseline after implementation.
Council decision §4.1 recorded in ADR-027 and governance manifest. Evolution triggers documented for future Memory Engineer retrieval.
